name: MonarchPhoneCountrySelect
title: PhoneCountrySelect
wrapsNative: MonarchCombobox (androidx.compose.material3.ExposedDropdownMenuBox with androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet) over a bundled ITU-T E.164 calling-code table, country names from java.util.Locale.getDisplayCountry
summary: A searchable picker of the country calling code of a phone number: each country by name with its code, such as "Portugal (+351)".
whenToUse: Before or beside a phone number field, when the number is stored with its country and calling code.
whenNotToUse: For a country of residence or an address use MonarchCountrySelect; for a whole phone number field with formatting use MonarchPhoneInput when it is available.
api: @Composable fun MonarchPhoneCountrySelect(selected: String?, onSelectedChange: (code: String?, dialCode: String?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, locale: Locale? = null, countries: List<String>? = null, preferred: List<String> = emptyList(), presentation: MonarchComboboxPresentation = MonarchComboboxPresentation.Automatic, enabled: Boolean = true, showFlag: Boolean = false, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, clearOptionLabel: String? = null, labels: MonarchPhoneCountrySelectLabels = MonarchPhoneCountrySelectLabels())

class MonarchPhoneCountrySelectLabels(label: String? = null, suggested: String? = null, all: String? = null, empty: String? = null, option: ((name: String, dialCode: String) -> String)? = null, combobox: MonarchComboboxLabels = MonarchComboboxLabels())

options.name: selected
options.description: The chosen ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in any case, or null.

options.name: onSelectedChange
options.description: Called with the chosen upper-case code and its calling code ("+44"), or two nulls when the selection is cleared.

options.name: locale
options.description: The language of the country names and of the sort order. null uses the first locale of the configuration.

options.name: countries
options.description: Limits the list to these codes; unknown codes are dropped. null lists every country with a calling code.

options.name: preferred
options.description: Codes listed first under "Suggested" while nothing is typed, such as the person's own country.

options.name: presentation
options.description: Menu, Sheet, or Automatic: a menu for up to eight countries, a sheet otherwise.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the list can be opened.

options.name: showFlag
options.description: Shows the flag emoji at the end of each row. Off by default because TalkBack reads a flag emoji as "Flag:" and the name, repeating it.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown in the empty field while nothing is chosen.

options.name: errorText
options.description: An error message; replaces the helper text and is set as the field's error.

options.name: clearOptionLabel
options.description: Adds a first row that clears the selection. Hidden while searching.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings: the label "Country code", "Suggested", "All countries", "No matching country", the row text "%1$s (%2$s)" and the combobox's own strings.

states.name: closed
states.description: The field shows the chosen country's label, or the placeholder (or the floating label) while nothing is chosen.

states.name: open
states.description: The bottom sheet (or, for eight options or fewer, the menu) lists the options; while nothing is typed the suggested ones come first under their heading.

states.name: searching
states.description: Typing filters the list, best matches first, without headings; when nothing matches the list says so.

states.name: error
states.description: The field has the danger outline and the message below it, and the message is the field's error for TalkBack.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The field takes the disabled colors and does not open.

appearance: The field is MonarchCombobox's: MonarchTextField's colors, a surface fill with the input border, the danger strong color in error; the sheet is on the surface color, second lines, hints and headings are muted text and the chosen row's radio mark is the accent strong color. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Built on MonarchCombobox, so long lists open a Material 3 bottom sheet with a search field instead of the web's popover. Neither Android nor the JDK exposes calling codes, so the ITU-T E.164 table is bundled: the same table as the web component (Monarch, MIT), whose calling codes are public assignments of the ITU. The web's matchPhoneCountry and getPhoneCountry helpers are internal here; MonarchPhoneInput, when built, is expected to share the table. There is no clear button: a phone number always needs a country, and clearOptionLabel adds a clear row when an app needs one. iOS has no PhoneCountrySelect yet; the name is the planned shared one.
accessibility: The field is MonarchCombobox's Material 3 exposed dropdown anchor: TalkBack reads the label, the chosen value and the expand state; double tap opens the list.

Every row is read with its label, second line and hint, and the chosen row is selected with a filled radio mark, so the choice does not rely on color; in the sheet each row is a radio button at least 48dp high.
The headings over suggested and other entries are headings; the no-match message is a polite live region.
The error is the field's error semantics and is shown as text.
edgeCases: Several countries share a calling code (+1, +44, +7); each is listed under its own name, and typing "+1242" finds the Bahamas through its leading digits.
Typing "44" or "+44" finds the countries with that code.
Unknown codes in countries and preferred are ignored; a selected code without a calling code shows an empty field.
Kosovo is listed as XK, a user-assigned code that the platform names.

examples.title: Beside a phone number
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space2)) {
    MonarchPhoneCountrySelect(
        selected = country,
        onSelectedChange = { code, dial ->
            country = code
            dialCode = dial
        },
        preferred = listOf({{preferred.0}}, {{preferred.1}}),
        labels = MonarchPhoneCountrySelectLabels(label = {{countryLabel}}),
    )
    MonarchTextField(
        value = number,
        onValueChange = { number = it },
        label = {{phoneLabel}},
        helperText = {{savedAs}} + " " + (dialCode ?: "—") + " " + number.ifEmpty { {{numberPlaceholder}} },
    )
}
examples.code:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space2)) {
    MonarchPhoneCountrySelect(
        selected = country,
        onSelectedChange = { code, dial ->
            country = code
            dialCode = dial
        },
        preferred = listOf("GB", "US"),
        labels = MonarchPhoneCountrySelectLabels(label = "Country code"),
    )
    MonarchTextField(
        value = number,
        onValueChange = { number = it },
        label = "Phone number",
        helperText = "Saved as" + " " + (dialCode ?: "—") + " " + number.ifEmpty { "…" },
    )
}
